content: OkHttp CHANGELOG (raw GitHub, fetched 2026-09-29): latest 5.5.0 (2026-08-16); 5.2.1 2025-10-09. 5.0.0 splits into okhttp-jvm/okhttp-android KMP variants via Gradle module metadata; Response.body became non-null (4.x nullable) - same JVM signature; legacy com.squareup.okhttp3:mockwebserver (package okhttp3.mockwebserver) still published in 5.x, marked obsolete, depends on JUnit4 + mockwebserver3; subclassing okhttp3.mockwebserver.QueueDispatcher is not source/binary compatible; Square states no binary breaks of non-alpha APIs. okhttp3.internal.* not stable (CT saw Util dropped).
